lede.en: The primary mark: the cart-and-signal symbol above the Cust²Mate wordmark. Use this version wherever the brand appears on its own.

note.en: Symbol gradient: the .ai files carry an Illustrator gradient-along-stroke, which exports as stepped slices. The color versions here rebuild it as a smooth vector gradient on the original stroke path, using the file's own color stops.

why.en: White lettering, symbol keeps its color.

text.en: Use the supplied files at their original proportions, with clear space of at least ¼ of the logo height on every side.
Don’t stretch, squash or otherwise distort the proportions.
Don’t recolor the mark — not even in the UI indigo. Use the supplied color, black or white versions.
Don’t place the color version on busy or mid-tone backgrounds. Switch to the white version, or add a solid panel.
Don’t rotate or tilt the logo.
Don’t add drop shadows, outlines, glows or other effects.
Don’t use the dark-lettering version on dark backgrounds — use Reversed or White.
Don’t split the gradient into flat colors or swap the colors around.

note.en: Illustrations, cart-display screens, photography composites, 40+ store environment renders, white-out packaging elements and the arrow vectors — original resolution.

desc.en: Packaging is rendered unbranded and white so the image reads as retail in general, not as any one brand’s product — with one full-color hero item when the story needs a target.
The orange-to-pink arrow or ribbon is the single warm accent. It carries the message; everything else stays neutral or cool.
Store aisles and offices are tinted toward the UI indigo/blue so photography and interface share one palette.
Every asset is cut out on transparency (PNG/WebP) so it sits on white, on Indigo 100 tints or on dark sections without a box.
